data.name: Fiachra
data.gender_notes: Fiachra is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fiachra is an Irish name derived from the Old Irish word 'fiach', which means 'handsome' or 'ruddy'. The name is also believed to mean 'royal' or 'powerful'. The name Fiachra carries the meaning “Royal, Handsome” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fiachra usually hope their child will grow to embody royal, handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Fiachra belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Royal, Handsome.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fiachra total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: פיאכرا
in_hebrew.meaning: פיאכרא הוא שם נוצרי אירי שמשמעותו 'רוח חזקה' או 'אש'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פיאכרא הוא שם נוצרי אירי שמקורו בשפה הגאלית. משמעותו היא 'רוח חזקה' או 'אש', ויש לו קשרים רוחניים עמוקים עם המיסיון הנוצרי באירלנד. השם קשור לסנט פיאכרא, קדוש נוצרי אירי מהמאה ה-7, שהיה מיסיונר ומנהיג דתי באירלנד.

in_greek.name: Φιάχρα
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Φιάχρα είναι ένα Χριστιανικό όνομα Ιρλανδικής προέλευσης, που σημαίνει 'روح قوية' ή 'Φωτιά'. Στην Ελληνική Ορθόδοξη παράδοση, το όνομα συνδέεται με την έννοια της πνευματικής φωτιάς και της ισχυρής πνευματικής δύναμης.

in_latin.name: Fiachra
in_latin.long_meaning: Fiachra is a Christian name of Irish origin, derived from the Gaelic language. It signifies 'strong spirit' or 'fire', reflecting the fiery passion and spiritual fervor of the early Christian missionaries in Ireland. The name is associated with Saint Fiachra, an Irish saint and missionary of the 7th century.

in_english.name: Fiachra
in_english.meaning: Fiachra means a strong spirit or fiery passion
in_english.long_meaning: Fiachra is a Christian name originating from Ireland, derived from the Gaelic language. It means 'strong spirit' or 'fiery passion', symbolizing the zeal and fervor of Christian missionaries. Saint Fiachra, an Irish saint from the 7th century, bore this name. The name reflects spiritual strength, courage, and devotion, making it a meaningful choice for Christian parents.

data.cultural_impact: Fiachra is a name deeply rooted in Irish culture, reflecting the beauty and strength of the Celtic people. It was a popular male name in Ireland throughout the Middle Ages, and remains so in some Irish communities to this day. Fiachra is also associated with the ancient Irish legend of Saint Fiachra, a bishop and missionary who is said to have brought Christianity to Ireland in the 5th century.
data.spiritual_significance: For Irish Christians, the name Fiachra carries a rich spiritual significance, reminding us of the power and beauty of the Christian faith as it took root in Ireland. The name is a reminder of the Celtic saints who lived and died in faith, spreading the gospel and building communities of believers in a land far from the mainstream of Europe. Fiachra is a name that encourages us to reflect on the power of the Spirit to transform lives and bring people to Christ, even in the most remote corners of the world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Fiachra is derived from the Irish word "fiac," meaning "handsome, vigorous, or strong." In Christian tradition, Saint Fiachra is believed to have been a missionary and bishop in Ireland during the early medieval period. His name evokes the strength and beauty of God's creation, as well as the power of the Christian mission to spread the word of God.

historical_references.reference: Fiachra was an Irish saint, the son of Fidghessa, King of Connacht. He was known as a healer and a champion of the poor, and his feast day is celebrated on July 1.

Another legend tells that Fiachra was a magician and the foster-son of the High King of Ireland, Lugh. He is said to have lived during the 3rd and 4th centuries AD and was the patron saint of the forests, hunting, and fertility.

modern_usage.modern_context: Fiachra is an ancient Irish name believed to mean "rich, ruddy-complexioned" in Gaelic. Today, it's experiencing a renewed interest, particularly among those with Irish heritage or those seeking unique names for their children. Fiachra can be found on Irish-themed bars and restaurants, social media platforms, and genealogy websites. The name has a mystical and romantic appeal, often associated with Irish mythology and folklore.

name_in_real_life.story: Grace Fiachra, a minister in Jerusalem, Israel, shares that their name Fiachra meaning "Royal, Handsome" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
